articles.title: Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga announced for PS5, Switch 2, Switch, and PC - Gematsu
articles.description: TAITO has announced Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga for PlayStation 5, Switch 2, Switch, and PC (Steam). It will launch in 2027. It will be published by Clear River Games in the west.
